Name: Shorter Sheds
Author: x7eventy7
Description:
[font=Tahoma][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/BLupZwo.png[/img]﻿
This mod retextures both the shed and big shed to reduce their visual size, giving you more space to view your farm. The buildings remain paintable and are only visually changed; the inside of both are completely unaltered.
[/size][/font][font=Tahoma][size=4][size=4][size=4][size=4][size=4][size=4]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wbISYFz.png[/img]﻿

[*][size=4]Run the game using [i]"SMAPI"[/i][/size]
